svg.title: The farming axis across an eastern dairy valley
svg.desc: A block diagram of a dairy valley with a creek on its floor, small fields of hay, corn, and pasture divided by hedgerows and stone walls, a dairy farm with a barn and two silos, a village with a church steeple, and woods along the ridge. Arrays sit in seven places, each outlined in the color of its farming-axis position. S0: a reclaimed quarry in the hillside, grazed under the panels. S1: a hillside sheep pasture that stays a pasture, and a heifer yard shaded by a small array beside the barn. S2: a silage-corn field turned to hay under an array. S3: a whole hay field taken beside the substation. S4: an old field going to brush on the upper slope. S5: a creekside field that used to wash into the creek, now in perennial cover under panels.
